nodes.name: Webhook - ROI Event
nodes.notes: Receives ROI events from all automations. Expected fields: leadSource, jobType, estimatedJobValue, status (Booked/Completed/Lost), automationResponsible, timestamp, clientId

nodes.name: Store in Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Appends all ROI events to Google Sheets for persistent storage and analysis. Each row represents one trackable event.

nodes.name: Schedule - Monthly Report
nodes.notes: Triggers on the 1st of each month at midnight to generate monthly ROI reports

nodes.name: Read Monthly ROI Data
nodes.notes: Retrieves all ROI events from Google Sheets for monthly analysis

nodes.name: Calculate ROI Metrics
nodes.notes: Attribution engine: Calculates revenue generated, recovered, time saved, conversion rates, and attributes value to specific automations

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ {
  "model": $env.LLM_MODEL || "gpt-4",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "You are an executive business analyst. Generate a concise, confident, non-technical monthly report for an HVAC business owner. Focus on financial outcomes and business impact. Use plain English. Be direct and compelling."
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Generate an executive summary for this automation ROI data:

Period: " + $json.period + "
Total Revenue: $" + $json.summary.totalRevenue + "
Revenue Recovered: $" + $json.summary.revenueRecovered + "
Revenue Generated: $" + $json.summary.revenueGenerated + "
Jobs Completed: " + $json.summary.jobsCompleted + "
Jobs Booked: " + $json.summary.jobsBooked + "
Conversion Rate: " + $json.summary.conversionRate + "%
Average Job Value: $" + $json.summary.avgJobValue + "
Time Saved: " + $json.summary.timeSavedHours + " hours
Labor Cost Saved: $" + $json.summary.laborCostSaved + "
No-Shows Prevented: " + $json.summary.noShowsPrevented + "
Revenue Growth: " + $json.summary.revenueGrowth + "%

Automation Breakdown:
" + JSON.stringify($json.automationBreakdown, null, 2) + "

Write a compelling 3-4 paragraph executive summary highlighting the most impactful metrics. Start with the headline number. Make cancellation psychologically difficult."
    }
  ],
  "temperature": 0.7,
  "max_tokens": 500
} }}

nodes.name: Generate Executive Summary (LLM)
nodes.notes: Uses LLM (GPT-4 or similar) to generate plain-English executive summary that makes the value clear and cancellation difficult

nodes.name: Merge Summary with Data
nodes.notes: Combines the AI-generated summary with raw metrics data for report delivery

nodes.name: Check for Alerts
nodes.notes: Flags clients with low ROI, falling engagement, or data gaps for internal agency follow-up

nodes.name: Check Data Quality
nodes.notes: Identifies clients with insufficient data collection for accurate ROI reporting

nodes.name: 📋 Configuration Guide
nodes.notes:
ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES REQUIRED:

✅ GOOGLE_SHEET_ID - Google Sheet for ROI data storage
✅ CLIENT_ID - Unique client identifier (optional for multi-client)
✅ CLIENT_EMAIL - Client's email for reports
✅ CLIENT_PHONE - Client's phone for SMS (optional)
✅ AGENCY_EMAIL - Agency sending email
✅ INTERNAL_AGENCY_EMAIL - Internal team email
✅ LLM_API_URL - OpenAI or compatible API endpoint
✅ LLM_MODEL - Model name (e.g., gpt-4)
✅ SMS_API_URL - Twilio API URL (optional)
✅ LOW_ROI_THRESHOLD - Alert threshold (default: 5000)
✅ MIN_EVENTS_THRESHOLD - Data quality threshold (default: 5)

CREDENTIALS NEEDED:
- Google Sheets OAuth2
- OpenAI API
- SMTP (email)
- Twilio API (SMS, optional)

nodes.notes:
POST to webhook with JSON payload:

{
  "clientId": "client-123",
  "leadSource": "Website Form",
  "jobType": "AC Repair",
  "estimatedJobValue": 2500,
  "status": "Completed",
  "automationResponsible": "Lead Qualification Bot"
}

Status values: Booked | Completed | Lost

Integrate from:
- Missed call recovery system
- Lead qualification forms
- CRM webhooks
- Appointment booking
- Any automation that touches revenue

nodes.name: 🏗️ System Architecture
nodes.notes:
FLOW:

1. Real-time Event Capture
   → Webhook receives ROI events
   → Store in Google Sheets
   → Immediate response

2. Monthly Processing
   → Scheduled trigger (1st of month)
   → Read all events from sheets
   → Calculate metrics & attribution
   → Generate AI summary

3. Report Distribution
   → Client: HTML email + SMS
   → Agency: Internal report with alerts

4. Quality Monitoring
   → Flag low ROI clients
   → Detect data gaps
   → Track engagement
